headline: Moriel Group Removed from South African Contractor Register
summary: Moriel Infrastructure Group was removed from the Construction Industry Development Board's National Register of Contractors following an investigation into financial and technical capability misrepresentation.
why: CIDB registration is mandatory for bidding on public infrastructure projects in South Africa, and removal halts commercial operations in the public sector.

impacts.name: Moriel Infrastructure Group
impacts.why: Removal from the national register bars the firm from participating in public sector construction contracts.
